verdict.rationale: Folk documents a public REST API with JSON resource URLs, bearer-token auth, header-based versioning with a stated 1-year availability and 6-month deprecation policy, IETF rate-limit headers, 100-record batch endpoints, and CRUD coverage of people, groups, custom objects, deals, custom fields and enrichment, plus a quick-start guide. Probes confirm the developer portal is live with an agent-friendly llms.txt and markdown docs. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec found (all probed paths 404), API access appears limited to a higher pricing tier, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
